name: Phosphor
desc: A green monochrome CRT: one hue, hard edges, no gloss.
_note: NOT shipped in the app package -- this is the theme that proves §63e, the
`theme` package type: it is built by `ghpkg.py theme`, signed with the dev
key, and installed from the Packages page like an add-on. Keep it OUT of
a theme that already ships cannot test downloading one.
It carries sweep.png so a theme package's BINARY asset path is exercised
end to end on the console -- the manifest allow-list, the sha256, the
content check and the install. Since 0.0.938.0 that asset is also DRAWN:
background.kind "image" is rendered by GhUiBackground, and the file is
authored at exactly 1920x1080 so its scanlines land 1:1 on the canvas.
